name: Welsh Rarebit (Cheddar Toasts) with Tomato, Chives & Dressed Greens

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Place eggs, Dijon, Worcestershire, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp Worcestershire sauce
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Add to the bowl with the egg mixture and whisk once more to combine. Set aside.
Divide bread between two large baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
6 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Divide cheesy egg mixture between toast slices, spreading it to the edges. Working in batches, return toast to the oven and broil until topping is golden and bubbling at the edges, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, chop chives into small pieces. Place half in a large bowl along with oil, vinegar, honey, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing. (Reserve remaining chives for serving.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp honey
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to coat. Set aside.
Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds. Divide between toasts, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Divide Welsh rarebit between plates and sprinkle with reserved chives. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
